ambient variable declaration.description:
TS 1.0
declare const name: Type
Declares that a variable exists at runtime (e.g. injected by a script tag / global) without providing an implementation — type-checking only, erased at compile.

ambient function declaration.description:
TS 1.0
declare function name(arg: Type): ReturnType
Declares a function's signature that exists at runtime elsewhere (e.g. a global script), without an implementation.
